integrity: The proof independently derives a circulant recurrence for the side support numbers from the published extension characterization, fixes its eigenvalue by summing over cyclic indices, and eliminates every nonconstant Fourier mode by equality in the triangle inequality. A standalone numerical checker stress-tests the spectral and sideline-intersection identities; finite checks are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The rigidity theorem is restricted to equiangular convex polygons. It does not settle the full Horváth–Lángi polygonal problem for arbitrary polygons or classify all higher extension equations.
title: Illumination-homothety rigidity for equiangular polygons
